one_liner: Monitors Buy Box ownership, prices, and stock across 11 Puzzlup sales channels (10 Amazon markets + Bol.com + Webshop) — scrapes every 6 hours via Playwright on Tim's PC, updates margins, logs price changes, and cross-references inventory.

intelligence.notes: Advanced is sufficient for routine scrape cycles and data lookups. Expert needed when building/fixing platform app code (Next.js), debugging Playwright scraper logic, or designing new DB schema.

capabilities: Trigger Playwright price scraper on Tim's PC via Browser_Tasks queue in Supabase
Poll and validate scrape results across 11 channels (DE, FR, UK, US, CA, NL, BE, IT, ES, Bol.com, Webshop)
Update puzzlup_margins.price_incl_vat_local with latest scraped prices after each run
Auto-log price changes (up/down) to puzzlup_pricing_adjustments table
Cross-reference Inventory_Levels to auto-flip OOS/in-stock status per product
Monitor Buy Box ownership — flag when Puzzlup/Qualico loses the Buy Box
Detect and report currency mismatches, suppressed listings, and rating drops
Maintain price history and traceability for all 11 channels
Push all pricing data to Supabase after each scrape run
Read broadcast directives from Supabase Shared_Knowledge (network-listener)
Perform gap analysis — show TO LAUNCH opportunities across all channels
Push scraper script updates to GitHub (tim581/qualicoagents)

triggers.description: Price & Buy Box monitoring cycle — inserts Browser_Task into Supabase for Tim's PC Playwright executor to scrape all 11 channels, then validates results, updates margins, logs price changes, and cross-references inventory
triggers.frequency: Every 6 hours: 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00 Brussels time, every day

webhook.notes: No webhook trigger configured. All automation runs on schedule.

key_rules: NO Slack alerts — Tim explicitly removed all Slack notifications
NO Airtable updates — disabled per Tim
DO NOT upload files to Google Drive
Prices stored in local currency: UK=GBP, US=USD, CA=CAD, EUR markets=EUR
Always use live ECB rates from frankfurter.app — never fixed rates
AMZ DE = reference catalog for ALL markets — if a product is in DE but not another channel, it is a gap
ECO mats = EU-only — NEVER show ECO as a gap for UK, US, CA
White/Blanc/Creme trays = DISCONTINUED — never scrape or show
Skip products marked Shipped internationally or Import Fees Deposit Included
Only scrape FBM where there is NO FBA for that product/market combo
Webshop and Bol.com: buybox_seller = D2C — no Buy Box checks needed
ALL gaps shown as TO LAUNCH (blue) — NOT LISTED no longer used
Before scrape: snapshot prices; after scrape: compare and log changes to puzzlup_pricing_adjustments
Health thresholds: Issue=BB lost OR OOS OR rating<4.0; Warning=BB suppressed OR price>40% avg OR rating<4.5
Protocol v3.0: every workflow run READ Shared_Knowledge → DO work → WRITE findings back

subagents.purpose: Main price monitoring pipeline (v9.1). Cleans up old Browser_Tasks, inserts a new price-scrape task for Tim's PC Playwright executor, polls for completion, validates results, updates puzzlup_margins, logs price changes to puzzlup_pricing_adjustments, and cross-references Inventory_Levels for OOS flips.
Reads broadcast directives from Supabase Shared_Knowledge and updates the agent last_seen timestamp. Runs 3x/day as a lightweight heartbeat and directive check.
Utility subagent for extracting ASINs from Amazon product pages or URLs. Used during catalog setup and when adding new products to monitoring.
